parameters.description_en: The ID of the backup vault.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en:
The policy to update the retention period. Format: `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. The retention period is updated at an interval of {interval} starting from {startTime}.

*   startTime: the time at which the system starts to run a backup job. The time follows the UNIX time format. Unit: seconds.
*   interval: the interval at which the system runs a backup job. The interval follows the ISO 8601 standard. For example, PT1H indicates an interval of 1 hour, and P1D indicates an interval of one day.
parameters.description_zh:
更新保留时间策略。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间更新一次保留时间。

- startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位为秒。
- interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时，P1D表示间隔一天。

parameters.description_en: The retention period of the backup data. Unit: days. If you set the Disabled parameter to false, the backup is retained for the number of days specified by this parameter.
parameters.description_zh: 备份保留天数。若Disabled为false，则备份将保留该参数指定的天数。
parameters.help_en: The retention period of the backup data. Unit: days. If you set the Disabled parameter to false, the backup is retained for the number of days specified by this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留天数。若Disabled为false，则备份将保留该参数指定的天数
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to permanently retain the backup. Valid values:

*   true: The backup is permanently retained.
*   false: The backup is retained for the specified number of days.
parameters.description_zh:
备份是否永久保留。

- true：永久保留
- false：不永久保留，保留RetentionDays指定的天数。
